models_evaluated: 49 LLMs (individual models not named in abstract)

links.outcome: LLM detection (F1) of suicidal ideation across increasing conversational depth, versus clinicians
links.effect: F1 declined with depth across model families (p<0.001); clinicians showed no decline (mean F1 0.86 at 0 and 200 turns); largest decrease under adversarial context (p<0.001).
links.quote: F1 declined with depth across model families (p<0.001).

unlisted_practices: Restating instructions periodically in long conversations to restore LLM suicidal-ideation detection performance
Safety evaluation of mental health AI across sustained realistic and adversarial conversational trajectories rather than short-prompt benchmarks

screen.practice: instruction restatement (prompt guardrail) in long conversations
screen.reason: Empirically tests large language models detecting suicidal ideation across multi-turn conversational trajectories and evaluates instruction restatement as a prompt guardrail/mitigation strategy to recover detection performance.
